episodes.synopsis: ŹOOĻ makes a spectacular debut and has taken the spotlight. Meanwhile, TRIGGER's popularity is beginning to decline due to Ryunosuke's scandal. As the disquieting atmosphere unfolds, TRIGGER shows off their powerful singing and dancing on TV, but...
episodes.title: Threat

episodes.synopsis: TRIGGER goes missing when they're scheduled to perform at the Tokyo International Music Art Festival, so IDOLiSH7 and Re:vale work together to look for them. Ryunosuke is rescued sooner than the others thanks to Nagi's quick wits and rushes to Zero Arena, but...
episodes.title: Indestructible Soul

episodes.synopsis: IDOLiSH7 and Re:vale watch on as TRIGGER check in on each other. Tenn informs Nagi that Kujo Takamasa received a living will from Sakura Haruki. Nagi is shaken by the possible clue to finding the man he's been looking for...
episodes.title: The Angel and the Monster

episodes.synopsis: Sosuke decides to dissolve TRIGGER's contracts in order to protect Yaotome Agency. However, he allows them to continue calling themselves TRIGGER and sing their existing songs. With that in mind, Tenn and the others continue working independently and pledge to one another that they will aim to return to Zero Arena someday.
episodes.title: Comeback Play

episodes.synopsis: IDOLiSH7 and Re:vale begin receiving different types of jobs than they had been previously. They are obviously filling in for TRIGGER. Meanwhile, ŹOOĻ is taking on more and more work, and their popularity is skyrocketing. They even appear as guests on IDOLiSH7's show "Lovely Night With You!".
episodes.title: Dear Butterfly
Together We'll Dream a Neverending Dream
